scope: Fresh read-only raw/window audit, no training, inference, verifier or runtime claims.

conventions.duration_sample_count: T/50 represents sample-count convention; no measured timestamp column exists.
conventions.first_to_last_elapsed: (T-1)/50, assuming a constant 50 Hz sample rate.
conventions.annotation: Inclusive end-start+1; preserves existing direct Python indices [start:end+1]. README does not explicitly declare 0-based or 1-based indices. Do not infer scientifically confirmed alignment from policy reconstruction.
conventions.normalizer: Pure K6 train windows, f32 mean/std axes(0,2), clip std>=1e-6. Overlapping sample occurrences count repeatedly, matching scripts/backbone.py.
conventions.same_activity: both pure and same label_majority; excludes equal mixed or unlabeled windows
conventions.label_change: label_majority differs, including transitions to/from 0 and nonpure windows; ground-truth metadata, not model prediction change
conventions.distance: same-coordinate x_next[c,i]-x_prev[c,i] compares raw times separated by 64 samples; aligned overlap equality compares x_prev[c,64+i] with x_next[c,i].
conventions.raw_precision: raw physical summaries use text->float64; saved-window equality uses raw->float32 as builder does

temporal_correlations.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of 61 within-recording Pearson correlations; positional statistic first averages per adjacent pair within each recording. Actual raw series uses each sensor row once without flattening/repeating overlapping windows.

normalized_l2.note: No observations in this subset; quantiles undefined.

normalized_linf.note: No observations in this subset; quantiles undefined.

cautions: Pure support and annotation summaries use the inherited label policy, not a new annotation validation.
17,453 windows are not statistically independent because they overlap; use subject-level split and grouped uncertainty estimates.
Raw norm mixes g and rad/s and is descriptive only; normalized norm is dimensionless with a frozen train-fit map.
All-split summaries are exploratory descriptive audits. No thresholds, selection, or formal held-out validation outcome is inferred from these plots.

Historical scripts/06b_corr_semantics.py calls flattened overlapping-window arrays raw series; the fresh actual-raw correlations here instead read unique raw rows and avoid artificial concatenation boundaries.
Dataset README contains an old noncommercial license statement while saved UCI manifest declares CC BY 4.0; source conflict is unresolved here.
